name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.123.0 — review-legs.js sets SPEC_REVIEW_BASE in every leg subprocess's environment so a host check running inside the gate or suite leg can judge against the base this review is actually judging rather than a merge-base it re-derives from branch topology (which collapses onto the wrong commit once a branch has merged); plugin-bump.js resolveBase() honors it as a 40-hex-only candidate ahead of main/origin-main. replay.js's --record cross-checks a baseline-red or new pristine-red --legs claim against the cited review run's one CLEAN ledger row instead of trusting the claim on shape alone, and refuses one that row contradicts. replay.md's step 7 rung 3 now resolves a still-red pristine-baseline verification deterministically: a second still-red re-run with the same first failing line records setup-failed with pristine-red:<leg> and stops with its manifests retained, instead of asking the user a question the evidence cannot answer; a different or green result still falls through to the question seam. 7.122.0 — replay.js's --apply now runs a host-declared post-apply reconcile hook (replay.afterApply) between applying the mutation patch and committing it, staging exactly the declared paths so the mutation commit carries the same derived-artifact reconciliation a real build commit carries, excluding those paths from the canonical patch, and recording a setup-failed outcome on any hook refusal; size-ratchet.js gains --reconcile as the one-shot form of that reconciliation on the main tree. 7.121.0 — `/spec:mocks` retires the THEME state: `deriveState` no longer derives THEME, the driver's authoring/gate/reopen surfaces drop direction-composed, theme-picked, stop open theme and --reopen theme, and status.json stops carrying theme/directions/marks.themePicked — the chain is now SEED -> SHAPES -> KIT -> WIREFRAMES -> SIGNOFF -> APPROVED, with the theme picked by /spec:sketch after sign-off instead. Both doctrine homes (spec/doctrine/mocks.md, spec/commands/mocks.md) stop describing the retired state, and render-gate.js's --mocks comment is repointed at the new theme-pick timing.
